bench: tools/hbm_b2/q3sync/lockstep.sh (legacy vs __q3sync core top, identical random stimulus, cold reset + warm reset at cycle 2000)

edge.diagnosis: all 18 diffs are arg_out_flit (15 bits) in cycles 2128-2145 after the WARM reset only; cold reset clean. Every diff cycle has arg_out_v=0 or arg_fault=1 in BOTH versions (diag log lockstep_edge_diag_valid_fault.log). Cause: ot_hgi_coll_argmax_static out_flit and ot_hgi_coll_amerge datapath are non-reset registers; in the reset-assert cycle legacy async flops clear before the posedge while sync flops clear at it, so a non-reset register captures a different stale value. Result is disqualified by the sticky fault / not valid, so no functional difference observed, but this random bench cannot sign it off.
